statement_blocker: The repository does not select existence of a Markov partition versus a coding consequence, Axiom A versus Anosov or another hyperbolic system, the invariant set, partition definition, one-sided versus two-sided symbolic space, or conjugacy versus finite-to-one semiconjugacy. Choosing any variant would add missing mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix a compact manifold or metric/topological phase space, the diffeomorphism or homeomorphism and regularity class, the hyperbolic invariant set, all universe levels, and the symbolic alphabet and path space.
conclusion: Open: the catalog does not say whether a Markov partition exists, whether its itinerary map yields a subshift of finite type, or whether the coding is a surjective semiconjugacy, finite-to-one off boundaries, injective on a residual set, or a conjugacy.
candidate_scope_not_credited: existence of finite Markov partitions for a source-specified basic hyperbolic set of an Axiom A diffeomorphism
existence of arbitrarily small-diameter Markov partitions for a source-specified Anosov or C-diffeomorphism
construction of a one-sided or two-sided subshift of finite type from transition data
a continuous surjective coding map that semiconjugates the shift with the original dynamics
uniqueness, injectivity, finite-to-one behavior, or entropy consequences away from partition boundaries
excluded_degenerate_cases: Not frozen. The selected source must decide empty or singleton invariant sets, empty rectangles, overlapping boundaries and multiple itineraries, zero transition matrices or empty symbolic spaces, periodic boundary orbits, nontransitive basic sets, expansivity scale, and one-sided versus invertible two-sided dynamics.
